## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY with Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising and VXX (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION showing fear easing.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION and VIX BELOW TREND (1W: -13.48%). Stocks vs Bonds supportive: SPY (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -2.02%) RECOVERY → SPY/TLT ↑ rising. Credit mixed: Credit spread level (HYG/LQD) flagged as CREDIT STRESS ↑ even as HYG (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +0.01%) ABOVE TREND — monitor.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-accommodative: UUP (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.27%) CORRECTION and Dollar strength → flat, yield curve (1W: +0.22% | 1M: -1.41%) → flat / RECOVERY, TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -2.02%) — financial conditions modestly supportive of risk.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech and Financials leading: XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -0.78%) RECOVERY; Energy lagging/bifurcated: XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION. Style: Growth/momentum showing strength (XLK/XLF rising and sector breadth confirmed).

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities outperform but global participation present: SPY (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY vs EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -0.90%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY — EM and China participating but mixed on the month.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation rebounding: ARKK (1W: +6.45% | 1M: -7.01%) RECOVERY, IBIT (1W: +5.67% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY and IWM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -1.54%) RECOVERY — risk-on sentiment supporting higher-beta / thematic exposure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy commodities driving gains: USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND; base metals mixed: CPER (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -3.60%) RECOVERY. Gold spot tone: GLD (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -8.26%) RECOVERY — month weakness remains.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Bifurcated energy complex: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) while XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND — watch sector dispersion.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Breadth (10/11) plus SPY/TLT ↑ rising and VXX falling provide dual confirmation of the RISK-ON label. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR Divergence across core ETFs — SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT are RECOVERY (1W positive / 1M negative) which tempers conviction and signals a transitional rally.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclical/growth exposure given breadth and XLK strength: XLF (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -0.78%) RECOVERY, XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength; reduce exposure to energy cyclicals showing short-term weakness (XLE CORRECTION) and monitor credit spread signal.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY, Financials XLF (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -0.78%) RECOVERY, Biotech XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION, Natural Gas UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil complex USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND; watch gold GLD (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -8.26%) RECOVERY for month-performance risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency marker), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY/TLT 7.60 (stocks vs bonds momentum), XLK/XLF 2.74 (growth vs value posture).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, confirmed by SPY/TLT ↑ rising and VXX falling. Tech and Financials showing strength (XLK, XLF); key risk is the MAJOR divergence pattern (multiple core ETFs in RECOVERY) and a mixed credit signal to monitor.
